name: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited

facts.business: The company is in the pre-operational stage, planning to develop an integrated industrial and recreational park comprising hospitality, healthcare, retail, and commercial facilities on its land at Chingavanam, Kottayam, Kerala, after altering its object clause to include tourism and hospitality activities.
key_risks: Commencement of new activities pending approval from Department of Revenue, Government of Kerala
Company has not carried out manufacturing operations for several years
Project implementation dependent on obtaining requisite statutory and regulatory approvals
